title: Very Optimised
description: This Modpack has 20+ Optimisation mods and 35+ Quality Of Life Mods
body:
Experience Minecraft like never before with Very Optimized. It is a modpack made for the Fabric loader. This pack makes your game run smoothly. It gets the most out of your computer making the game run fast and feel responsive. This modpack will be only on Fabric for now.

It does this by using some mods that makes the game look good and run well. The modpack also includes some features that make playing Minecraft easier.

This modpack has a lot of performance and Quality of life mods

Overall this modpack makes playing minecraft enjoyable.
